sources.snippet: Natural Language Toolkit NLTK is a leading platform for building Python programs to work with human language data. sources.snippet: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a popular Python library used for natural language processing (NLP) tasks such as text preprocessing, analysis, and language modeling. It provides a wide range of tools and datasets that help developers process and understand human language efficiently.
